summary: Sourcey 3.6.5 godoc documentation for gin-gonic/gin, a maintained Go HTTP web framework (MIT license), pinned at commit 34dac209ffb6ef85cc78c5d217bbb7ad001d68fd. Built with the godoc adapter against the live Go toolchain (go1.26.5 darwin/arm64). The site documents 8 packages with 29+ exported API signatures across 9 HTML pages, including the root gin package, binding, render, ginS, codec/json, internal/bytesconv, and internal/fs. Deployed to GitHub Pages at https://rawnuke.github.io/gin-docs/.

observations.label: Sourcey config
observations.content: import { defineConfig, godoc } from "sourcey"; export default defineConfig({ name: "Gin Web Framework", siteUrl: "https://gin.pages.dev", repo: "https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin", editBranch: "master", navigation: { tabs: [{ tab: "Go API", source: godoc({ module: ".", packages: ["./..."] }) }] }, theme: { preset: "default", colors: { primary: "#00ADD8", light: "#00B5E2", dark: "#0087A8" } } });
